items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Row or column of toggle buttons sharing one pressed state (single or multiple, horizontal or vertical) on Base UI Toggle Group; pressed fills with ink and a solid square bullet.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. ToggleGroup takes `value`/`defaultValue` as string[], `multiple`, `orientation`, `loopFocus`, `disabled`; label it with aria-label. Each ToggleGroupItem needs a unique `value`.
